title: Dyadic granularity of a decision tree's coefficients
statement: Let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ Boolean variables, and let $S \subseteq \{0,\dots,n-1\}$ be a frequency set. Then the coefficient $\mathrm{coeffs}\,T\,S$ is a dyadic rational with denominator $2^{\mathrm{depth}(T)}$: there exists an integer $m \in \bbz$ such that \[ \mathrm{coeffs}\,T\,S = \frac{m}{2^{\mathrm{depth}(T)}}. \] Equivalently, every such coefficient is an integer multiple of $2^{-\mathrm{depth}(T)}$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a decision tree on n Boolean variables
S is a subset of Fin n (a frequency set)
